data.name: evaluation
data.shape: OwnEvaluation — score, bias, cost, chain, conditions, attributions, signals[] | none | unreadable
data.source: app.readOwnEvaluation.execute — the private projection: cost and reasoning the public read nulls

data.name: alloc:* / gate
data.shape: per-signal weight tiers 0–3 and a gate percentage
data.source: searchParams — the what-if form's GET round trip

components.purpose: The bottom of the agent's own stack: what one evaluation read, cost, followed, and would have scored under different weights.
components.current_implementation: max-w-3xl centered column: score line, conflict sentence as plain prose when signals disagreed, cost section, chain card, conditions, attributions, the simulator, the scorecard, back link.
constraints: None (the platform publishes no detail) and unreadable (the read failed) must never render alike.
No client JS — the simulator is a GET form round trip.

components.purpose: What this decision cost to think — yours alone; the public projection nulls it.
components.current_implementation: One sentence: model, provider, dollars to four places or 'cost not reported', duration, billing type. A model error renders with role=alert.
constraints: Null is not free: an unreported price and a price of zero are different facts, and only one should reassure.
role=alert on the model-error line must survive.

components.purpose: Gate → attempt → decision → execution → outcome, the platform's own words, absent stages absent.
components.current_implementation: One tokened card; execution message whitespace-pre-wrap, unparsed; the outcome line font-medium.
constraints: A stage the platform did not record is absent, never an empty row.
The execution message is the platform's own words, unparsed.

components.purpose: What the strategy's conditions said — the platform's own comparison, clause by clause; nothing re-evaluates anything.
components.current_implementation: Tally line (true-of-total, unresolved, strategy revision, provisional), verdict/decidedBy rendered verbatim the day they speak (only ever observed null — #147), tokened cards per condition with evidence clauses.
constraints: The platform publishing no condition evaluation is a real state, not 'all conditions passed' — no block renders for it.
verdict/decidedBy render verbatim when populated; they have only ever been observed null (backlog #147).
Evidence clauses are the platform's comparisons; nothing here re-evaluates.

components.purpose: What each contributing signal was worth to the aggregate.
components.current_implementation: Plain list: name or id, attribution percent, own score.
constraints: Rendered only when the platform published attributions.

components.purpose: What if it had weighted these differently — BattleGrid's own simulator over the weights, never the scores.

actions.effect: GET round trip: simulate_aggregate_score with the real scores and the chosen weights; nothing is saved

components.current_implementation: Per-fired-signal weight selects (0–3), a gate field, BUTTON_SECONDARY 'Score it', the result in a tokened card; a refusal renders role=alert in BattleGrid's words. Over-cap says the simulator cannot re-score rather than truncating.
constraints: Only the weighting is the user's to change — inventing scores would answer a question about a market that never existed.
Over the simulator's signal cap, the section refuses rather than truncates: dropping signals would score a different composition than the one that ran.
Nothing is saved, and the page says so; the strategy's rule editor is named as where a real change happens.
The submit is secondary — the simulation is a question, not a commit.

components.purpose: Every signal consulted, module by module — untriggered ones included.
components.current_implementation: Module groups with fired-counts; tokened left rails; Fired/Did-not-fire in words; the platform's sentence and indicator values per row.
constraints: Fired / did not fire is stated in words, never by colour alone.

components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component; treatment owned by DT-0006.

flows.name: Understand one read
steps: read the cost, chain and conditions

flows.name: What if
steps: read BattleGrid's own re-score beside the real one

accessibility.notes: Refusals and model errors carry role=alert. Fired state legible without colour. No client JS.
